cases.purpose: Select all eligible outside-session PIDs while excluding the real caller, its session, kernel and malformed records.
cases.oracle: Per case, guest-only parser and native seccomp controls run in setup. In the guarded candidate shell, each observation rechecks its actual PID, SID, and synthetic records; a fixture-role oracle specifies the selected set independently of candidate output. The none case first checks a nonempty baseline in that same shell and tree. The race case synchronizes stat FIFO read with deletion of that record cmdline.
cases.comparison: The primary must implement and independently review helpers/killall5-dry-run-reviewed-gate.json before using any runner verdict as migration evidence. The gate conditionally requires complete raw diagnostics and successful preconditions per observation, recomputes sets and status from fixture roles, and distinguishes infrastructure incompleteness from reached product mismatches, including the none baseline.
cases.candidate_script:
exec ./guard "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c 'printf '"'"'{"stage":"guard-enter","pid":%s}\n'"'"' "$$" >"$HOME/events.jsonl"
if ! ulimit -f 128; then printf '"'"'{"stage":"ulimit-failed"}\n'"'"' >>"$HOME/events.jsonl"; exit 90; fi
printf '"'"'{"stage":"ulimit-ok"}\n'"'"' >>"$HOME/events.jsonl"
printf '"'"'{"stage":"prepare-start"}\n'"'"' >>"$HOME/events.jsonl"
if ! /usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/killall5-dry-run-reviewed.py prepare baseline "$$" >"$HOME/prepare.log" 2>&1; then printf '"'"'{"stage":"prepare-failed"}\n'"'"' >>"$HOME/events.jsonl"; exit 90; fi
printf '"'"'{"stage":"prepare-ok"}\n'"'"' >>"$HOME/events.jsonl"
export BASHOS_PROC_ROOT=/tmp/parity-case/proc-fixture
printf '"'"'{"stage":"recheck-start","observation":"candidate"}\n'"'"' >>"$HOME/events.jsonl"
if ! /usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/killall5-dry-run-reviewed.py recheck baseline "$$" candidate >>"$HOME/prepare.log" 2>&1; then printf '"'"'{"stage":"recheck-failed","observation":"candidate"}\n'"'"' >>"$HOME/events.jsonl"; exit 90; fi
printf '"'"'{"stage":"recheck-ok","observation":"candidate"}\n'"'"' >>"$HOME/events.jsonl"
printf '"'"'{"stage":"observe-start","observation":"candidate"}\n'"'"' >>"$HOME/events.jsonl"
rc=0
killall5 --dry-run >"$HOME/candidate.out" 2>"$HOME/candidate.err" || rc=$?
printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$rc" >"$HOME/candidate.status"
printf '"'"'{"stage":"observe-end","observation":"candidate","status":%s}\n'"'"' "$rc" >>"$HOME/events.jsonl"
printf '"'"'{"stage":"verify-start"}\n'"'"' >>"$HOME/events.jsonl"
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/killall5-dry-run-reviewed.py verify baseline
rc=$?
printf '"'"'{"stage":"verify-end","status":%s}\n'"'"' "$rc" >>"$HOME/events.jsonl"
exit "$rc"
'
